# Example & Reference Files (`dist/`)

This directory serves as an **example and reference folder** for configuring **XtremeFork-Universal**.

## What's Included Here:

- [`Put in main folder/XtremeTool.ini`](Put%20in%20main%20folder/XtremeTool.ini) — Example default configuration template. You can copy this file into your GTA V directory and customize traffic multipliers, memory heap budgets, and entity pool limits.
- [`ReadMe_Install.txt`](ReadMe_Install.txt) — Quick plain-text installation guide.
- [`Documentation_Config.txt`](Documentation_Config.txt) — Detailed explanation of every parameter in `XtremeTool.ini`.

---

> [!NOTE]
> **Pre-compiled `.asi` Plugin Binaries:**  
> The compiled `XtremeTool.asi` plugin binary is no longer stored directly in this repository.  
> Download the pre-built release package (`XtremeFork-Universal-Windows-x64.zip`) directly from the **[Releases Tab](https://github.com/l0afi/XtremeFork-Universal/releases)**.
